name: Hydrodol REHYDRATION — Orange 10 Sachets
description:
Hydrodol 電解質補水沖劑是由四種電解質和葡萄糖的配方調製而成，有助於緩解脫水症狀，促進疾病恢復，並有助於恢復體內的電解質平衡。含有我們獨特的 HY.FIVE+ FORMULA，在國際公認的口服補水配方的基礎上，增加了鎂——一種重要但經常被忽視的電解質——以及來自 Aquamin 的 72 種微量礦物質，以補充在疾病期間可能流失的身體礦物質儲備。

用於緩解輕度脫水症狀：成人：視需要在 200 毫升水中添加 1 包（每天最多 3 包）。

支持能量水平，有助於從疾病中康復，維持能量產生，紓緩脫水症狀，支持體內電解質平衡，有助於運動後重補體內電解質平衡，支持骨骼、肌肉及神經系統健康。

警告：僅限按指示使用。如症狀持續，請諮詢您的醫療保健專業人員。含糖和亞硫酸鹽。每包（6.6克）含 340 毫克鈉和 157 毫克鉀。如果您有腎病或正在服用心臟或血壓藥物，請在使用前諮詢您的醫生或藥劑師。

name: Château Calon Ségur - Saint-Estèphe 3ème Cru GCC 2022
grape: 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: Superb wine from this historic Saint-Estèphe third growth. Unwinding with aromas of dark berries, cherries and blackcurrants mingled with violets, licorice and pencil shavings. Full-bodied, rich and concentrated with excellent structure and a lengthy finish.

name: Château Les Carmes Haut-Brion - Pessac-Léognan 2022
tasting_note: The finest wine bottled to date at this estate. Unfurling from the glass with aromas of violet, iris and black fruits with a seamless, rich, powerful palate. Extraordinary depth and length.

name: Château La Tour Carnet - Haut-Médoc GCC 2022
tasting_note: Blackberries, black cherries, flowers, tobacco leaf, cedar and espresso nuances. Creamy, lush and round on the palate with notes of espresso and chocolate on the finish.

name: Château Beychevelle - Saint-Julien 4ème Cru GCC 2022
tasting_note: Aromas of dark berries, cherries and cassis mingled with hints of violets and licorice. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and layered with a long, structured finish.

name: Connétable de Talbot - Saint-Julien 2022
tasting_note: Aromas of rich berries, loamy soil, cherries and licorice. A medium to full-bodied, fleshy and impressively concentrated second wine of Château Talbot.

name: Château Talbot - Saint-Julien 4ème Cru GCC 2022
tasting_note: Bursting with aromas of cherries, berries, orange zest and petals framed by toasty oak. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and layered with sweet fruit and impressive length.

name: Château d'Issan - Margaux 3ème Cru GCC 2022
grape: 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, 2% Cabernet Franc, 2% Malbec, 1% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: Luxurious, showing blackcurrants and orange peel with cedar and dried-mushroom aromas. Crunchy and lightly chalky tannins with a long, elegant Margaux finish.

name: Château Rauzan-Ségla - Margaux 2ème Cru GCC 2022
tasting_note: Aromas of dark berries and cherries mingled with licorice, burning embers and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, ample and creamy with extraordinary length.

name: Château La Fleur-Pétrus - Pomerol 2022
tasting_note: Deep garnet-purple. Nose of blueberry jam, mulberries and blackcurrant preserve with violets. Full-bodied, rich and concentrated with a silky texture and excellent structure.

name: Château d'Armailhac - Pauillac 5ème Cru GCC 2022
grape: 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 22% Merlot, 16% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: The epitome of contained power. Black fruit flavours mingled with floral, spice and mineral notes. Shows all the density of the vintage offset by great freshness and remarkable length.

name: Carruades de Lafite - Pauillac 2022
grape: 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc, 3% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: Youthfully understated bouquet of raspberries, cherries and cedary pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and layered with ripe cassis and excellent structure.

name: Château Clerc Milon - Pauillac 5ème Cru GCC 2022
grape: 59% Cabernet Sauvignon, 32% Merlot, 8% Cabernet Franc, 1% Carménère
tasting_note: Aromas of sweet crème de cassis, licorice, violets and creamy new oak. Full-bodied, rich and layered with ripe integrated tannins and impressive length.

name: Château Duhart-Milon Rothschild - Pauillac 4ème Cru GCC 2022
tasting_note: Aromas of mulberries, blackcurrants, pencil shavings and rose petal. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and textural with powdery tannins and lively acids. Harmonious and integrated.

name: Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste - Pauillac 5ème Cru GCC 2022
tasting_note: Aromas of cassis and plums mingled with rose petal, tobacco leaf and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and layered with excellent structure and a long finish.

name: Château Lynch-Bages - Pauillac 5ème Cru GCC 2022
grape: 66% Cabernet Sauvignon, 28% Merlot, 3% Cabernet Franc, 3% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: Rich aromatic palette of black and red fruits — blackcurrant, Morello cherry — topped by spicy notes with impressively mature tannins and remarkable acidity.

name: Aile d'Argent - Bordeaux Blanc 2022
grape: 52% Sauvignon Blanc, 39% Sémillon, 8% Sauvignon Gris, 1% Muscadelle
tasting_note: Citrus fruit aromas elevated by subtle touches of verbena and acacia honey. Generous and well-balanced, ripe white fruit flavours with appealing minerality and pleasant freshness.

name: Pastourelle de Clerc Milon - Pauillac 2022
grape: 52% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, 2% Carménère, 1% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: Wild bilberry and liquorice notes. Precision, freshness and opulence building a delightful harmonious wine with an elegant, persistent finish.

name: Le Petit Mouton de Mouton Rothschild - Pauillac 2022
grape: 71% Cabernet Sauvignon, 19% Merlot, 7% Cabernet Franc, 3% Petit Verdot
tasting_note: Remarkably intense aromas of black cherry and blackcurrant mingling with vanilla. Silky, creamy structure with richness and generosity, lifted by smoky, graphite and chocolate notes. Luscious finish.

name: Alpine Rift Sauvignon Blanc
tasting_note: The 2024 Alpine Rift Sauvignon Blanc is an elegant interpretation of the classic Marlborough style. Enticing aromas of white-fleshed nectarine, papaya and honeydew melon with a hint of mandarin and jalapeno on the nose are underpinned by a ripe, richly textured palate and crisp, citrus finish. Produced from all three sub-regions of Marlborough, raised in 90% tank and 10% barrel.

name: The Marlborist Grande Sauvignon Blanc
tasting_note: Not one bound by convention, The Marlborist Grande Sauvignon is a bold departure from the classic Marlborough style. Fermented entirely with naturally occurring yeast in a mixture of old French oak barrels and puncheons for 11 months, it is an alternative style with an alluring array of grilled peach, candied pineapple and brioche with hints of elderflower and almond. Moreish wine with a rich, creamy palate underpinned by a long, citrus finish.

name: The Marlborist Chardonnay
tasting_note: The Marlborist Chardonnay is a rich, dry elegant wine that is both intricate and textural with an enticing combination of roasted hazelnuts, brioche, citrus blossom and golden-queen peach with hints of clove spice and vanilla. Finely balanced wine with a creamy palate underpinned by a long, citrus finish.

name: The Marlborist Pinot Noir
tasting_note: An ethereal, highly perfumed pinot noir hailing from Marlborough's Southern Valleys. A delicious combination of boysenberries, Black Doris plum, lavender and liquorice are underpinned by elegant, finely integrated tannins, with hints of cinnamon-clove spice and a dry, earthy finish.

name: Bevobianco DOC Maremma Toscana
tasting_note: Bitter and saline but refreshing, with aromas of daffodil, lime, grapefruit and almond. Palate has sweeter energy of white peaches, lemon-lime soda and white tea leaves. On the finish, nutty salinity returns for a savory, warm parting note.

name: Bevorosso DOC Maremma Toscana
tasting_note: Fresh and balanced wine. Fermentation in stainless steel tanks, aged 12 months in the bottle. Soft and long-lasting, characterized by sweet and varietal hints of wild berries.

name: Sacello Chianti Classico Annata DOCG
tasting_note: Attractive nose of dark cherries, chocolate, orange, licorice and a hint of crushed hazelnuts. Medium-bodied, juicy with spicy, savoury nuances at the end.

name: Poggio Croce Chianti Classico Riserva DOCG
tasting_note: Bright ruby red with subtle brightening. Elegant aromas of oranges and pomegranate, subtle hint of graphite, touch of dried rose petal. Elegant, polished and juicy on the palate, with radiant fruit, juicy cherries and a powerful finish.

name: Terrebianca Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG
tasting_note: Black cherry, dried herbs, tobacco, incense, licorice and mocha. Beautifully amplified in this resonant, super expressive Gran Selezione. All elements are very nicely balanced.

name: Campaccio IGT Toscana Rosso
tasting_note: 70% Sangiovese, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot. Packed with dark-toned fruit, leather, spice, licorice and mocha. Ample and resonant on the palate offering tons of textual intensity and power. All elements impeccably balanced.

name: Campaccio Collezione IGT Toscana Rosso
tasting_note: 40% Sangiovese, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot. Aged in stainless steel on fine lees, then French oak 20 months, 12 months bottle ageing. Supple aromas of pencils and leather mingle with pungent notes of soil and herbs. Strong yet pliable tannins with jubilant acid.

name: Etna Bianco Superiore
tasting_note: 100% Carricante. Brilliant golden hue. Citrus notes of lime with bergamot, linden, helichrysum, rock salt. Iodine echoes and bursts of sea salt. Slender, sharp and savory sip, almost salty. Pure mineral verticality with long and persistent finish.

name: Etna Rosso
tasting_note: 80% Nerello Mascalese, 20% Nerello Cappuccio. Blood orange, juniper berries, cinchona and tamarind against magmatic background of graphite. Vegetal notes of musk, tobacco leaf and licorice root. Muscular and balanced body with fresh savory note and silky tannins.

name: Etna Rosso Contrada Feudo di Mezzo
tasting_note: 80% Nerello Mascalese, 20% Nerello Cappuccio. Chinotto, marasca cherry, Sicilian mint on ethereal bouquet with nuances of iodine. Rhubarb, medicinal herbs, golden Virginia tobacco, dark chocolate. Fresh savory body with noble tannins. Very persistent finish.

name: Etna Rosso Piede Franco Quota 900
tasting_note: 80% Nerello Mascalese, 20% Nerello Cappuccio. Ungrafted vineyard in extinct crater at 943m. Red orange jam, black mulberries, Etna blackberries on magmatic background. Iron hints, anise, oregano, capers. Fresh, pleasant and elegant sip with savory trail and harmonious tannins.

name: Saturnalia Bianco
tasting_note: Orange wine. Blend of Trebbiano Toscano and Procanico with three weeks skin contact. Yellow with amber reflections. Fruity and lightly balsamic nose. Hints of honey, very ripe fruit, summer wild flora on the palate.

name: UNI
tasting_note: 100% Procanico from 30–35 year old vines. Natural yeast fermentation, 3 weeks maceration, aged in stainless steel 7 months. Fruity nose of apple and plum with wildflowers, sage and marjoram.

name: Saturnalia Rosso
tasting_note: Vineyards 15–60 years old. Ruby red with garnet reflections. Prevalence of red fruit, cherry with blackberry, withered rose, humus and black pepper notes. Medium structure, long persistence and fine chewy tannins.

name: Rosso
tasting_note: 100% Ciliegiolo. Lively with abundance of freshness. Intense nose with marasca cherries, dehydrated plums and currants, dried rose, balsamic nuances and Mediterranean scrub. Fresh and structured with ripe and elegant tannins.

name: Tarconte
tasting_note: 35 year old vines on volcanic ash soils with tuffaceous base. Best selection of Sangiovese from volcanic soil. Complex with earthy depth, dark fruit and a long mineral finish.

name: AOP Côtes du Rhône Villages Valréas Blanc
tasting_note: Bright yellow with intense green reflections. Wild essences, citrus, exotic fruits, and definite minerality on the nose. Extraordinary freshness on the palate, with richness and fat coating the palate resulting in a sensation of fullness.

name: «Comme un Saphir» AOP Côtes du Rhône Villages Blanc
tasting_note: 100% Roussanne on the heights of the estate. Hyper-verticality and creamy breadth. Omnipresent minerality perfectly responds to taste buds. Elegant length, facets of the soil appear chiseled.

name: La Petite Bellane AOP Côtes du Rhône Villages Rouge
tasting_note: Deep purple with intense violet highlights. Unique mineral character of mountain soils, subtle nuances of moderate sun exposure. Harmonious progression on the palate.

name: AOP Côtes du Rhône Villages Valréas Rouge
tasting_note: Deep crimson with intense violet reflections. Graphite, mentholated blackcurrant, green pepper with terroir touch evolving towards high-altitude garrigue, olives, camphor and undergrowth. Velvety tannins supported by freshness of the terroir.

name: «Saint Jacques» AOP Vinsobres
tasting_note: 65% Grenache 60 years old vines and 35% Syrah 40 years old vines. Deep crimson with intense violet reflections. Graphite, mentholated blackcurrant, green pepper with terroir touch. Velvety tannins.

name: «Les Echalas» AOP Côtes du Rhône Villages Valréas
tasting_note: Organic certified. Cool climate at 410m altitude. Clay-limestone provides elegant mineral edge. 8 week traditional maceration, aging in 225 litre barrels. Cherry and blackberry with hints of soot and coffee. Rich and powerful yet beautifully balanced, with fine, dense, precise tannins.

name: «Urgonien - 1,14 hectare» AOP Châteauneuf du Pape
tasting_note: Purity of fruits, complexity of terroir, elegance that is paradoxically both concentrated and refreshing. Black fruits, olives, and oriental spices on the nose. Richness supported by freshness and salinity. Very stimulating and rich combination without being cloying.

name: Cape Swallow Chenin Blanc 2023
description: Classic Chenin Blanc aromas of green apples, white pear and citrus bloom lift from the glass. The palate is dry and focused, with refreshing acidity and notes of quince, lemon zest, and a hint of wet stone. A clean, mineral finish lingers, showcasing finesse and balance.
description_zh: 清新的青蘋果、白梨及柑橘花香撲鼻而來，入口乾爽集中，清新酸度帶出榅桲、檸檬皮及礦石氣息，收結悠長而清冽，充分展現品種的優雅與平衡。
tasting_note: Green apple, white pear, citrus bloom. Dry and focused with quince, lemon zest and wet stone. Clean mineral finish.

name: Cape Swallow Chardonnay 2023
description: Aromas of lemon curd, ripe stone fruit, and toasted almond lead to a finely textured palate. Notes of white peach, citrus zest, and a hint of vanilla are supported by a fresh line of acidity and a delicate, creamy finish. Gilbert & Gaillard Double Gold — 92 pts.
description_zh: 檸檬凝乳、熟石果及烤杏仁香氣，口感細膩，白桃、柑橘皮及淡淡雲呢拿風味，以清新酸度支撐，收結奶滑悠長。Gilbert & Gaillard 雙金獎 92 分。
tasting_note: Lemon curd, stone fruit, toasted almond. White peach, citrus zest, vanilla. Creamy finish. Gilbert & Gaillard Double Gold 92pts.

name: Cape Swallow Syrah 2023
description: Expressive aromas of blackberry, plum, and cracked black pepper layered with notes of violet and graphite. Focused and textured palate showing dark fruit, subtle spice, and savoury undertones. Fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity lead to a long, mineral-driven finish. Gilbert & Gaillard Double Gold — 90 pts.
description_zh: 黑莓、李子及現磨黑椒香氣濃郁，帶紫羅蘭及石墨氣息。入口集中而有質感，黑色果實、香料及鹹鮮底蘊，單寧細緻，酸度清鮮，礦物感收結悠長。Gilbert & Gaillard 雙金獎 90 分。
tasting_note: Blackberry, plum, cracked black pepper, violet. Dark fruit, subtle spice, savoury tannins. Long mineral finish. Gilbert & Gaillard Double Gold 90pts.

name: Cape Swallow Pinot Noir 2023
description: Aromas of wild strawberry, red cherry, and rose petal lead to a refined palate of cranberry, subtle spice, and forest floor. Silky tannins and fresh acidity provide balance and tension, while a long, mineral finish highlights the wine's finesse and terroir expression. Gilbert & Gaillard Gold.
description_zh: 野草莓、紅櫻桃及玫瑰花瓣香氣優雅，口感精緻，蔓越莓、淡淡香料及森林底蘊相互交融，絲滑單寧與清新酸度帶來平衡感，礦物感悠長收結。Gilbert & Gaillard 金獎。
tasting_note: Wild strawberry, red cherry, rose petal. Cranberry, subtle spice, forest floor. Silky tannins, long mineral finish. Gilbert & Gaillard Gold.

name: La Manufacture Saint Bris Sauvignon 2023
description: Saint-Bris is a unique Burgundy appellation — the only AOC in the region to feature Sauvignon Blanc. Benjamin Laroche's La Manufacture bottling is crisp and vivid, with aromas of white grapefruit, fresh herbs and a lively mineral spine typical of the Kimmeridgian limestone soils of Yonne.
description_zh: Saint-Bris 是 Burgundy 唯一出產 Sauvignon Blanc 的法定產區。Benjamin Laroche 的 La Manufacture 版本清爽明快，白柚、鮮草香氣，以 Kimmeridgian 石灰岩土壤賦予的礦物感貫穿始終。

name: La Manufacture Petit Chablis 2023
description: A bright, expressive Petit Chablis from Benjamin Laroche's La Manufacture range. Clean aromas of green apple, lemon and white flower lead to a crisp, refreshing palate with characteristic Chablis minerality and a clean, dry finish. An ideal aperitif or seafood companion.
description_zh: Benjamin Laroche La Manufacture 系列的 Petit Chablis，清新的青蘋果、檸檬及白花香氣，入口清爽，帶有 Chablis 標誌性的礦物感，收結乾淨利落。最佳餐前酒或海鮮配搭。

name: La Manufacture Petit Chablis Organic 2023
description: A brilliant pale gold colour. Lovely aromas of white flowers and citrus with a slight mineral touch. Fresh, sweet lemon juice and golden delicious apples. A nice balance of ripe fruity flavour and lots of crisp, fresh lemons on the finish.
description_zh: La Manufacture Petit Chablis 的有機版本，不使用合成農藥或除草劑。柑橘及青蘋果香氣明亮，口感清新精準，有機農法令這款 Chablis 的純淨礦物感更為突出。
tasting_note: A brilliant pale gold colour. Lovely aromas of white flowers and citrus with a slight mineral touch. Fresh, sweet lemon juice and golden delicious apples. A nice balance of ripe fruity flavour and lots of crisp, fresh lemons on the finish.

name: La Manufacture Bourgogne Chablis Vieilles Vignes 2023
description: Old vine Chardonnay from the Chablis appellation, offering greater depth and concentration than the village level. Aromas of white peach, citrus and chalk lead to a focused, mineral-driven palate. The age of the vines adds texture and complexity to the characteristic Chablis freshness.
description_zh: 來自 Chablis 的老藤 Chardonnay，深度與集中度超越村莊級。白桃、柑橘及白堊香氣，口感集中，礦物感突出，老藤賦予額外質感，在 Chablis 特有的清新中帶出複雜層次。

name: La Manufacture Bourgogne Pinot Noir Côtes d'Auxerre 2022
description: A charming Pinot Noir from the Côtes d'Auxerre, one of Burgundy's most exciting up-and-coming regions. Light ruby in colour with aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle earth. The palate is silky and supple with fine tannins and a fresh, mineral finish — a wonderful introduction to Burgundy rouge.
description_zh: 來自 Burgundy 新興產區 Côtes d'Auxerre 的迷人 Pinot Noir。淡寶石紅色，紅櫻桃、覆盆子及淡淡泥土香氣，入口絲滑柔順，單寧細緻，礦物感收結清新——入門 Burgundy 紅酒的絕佳選擇。

name: La Manufacture Irancy "Quarante Journaux" 2023
description: Named after an old unit of land measurement, 'Quarante Journaux' (Forty Journaux) is La Manufacture's flagship red from Irancy — a rare Burgundy appellation prized for its structured, deep Pinot Noir. Dark cherry, wild herbs, and earthy spice with a firm, lingering finish. A wine with real Burgundian character and ageing potential.
description_zh: 以古老土地計量單位命名，「Quarante Journaux」（四十日耕）是 La Manufacture 來自 Irancy 的旗艦紅酒。Irancy 是 Burgundy 罕見的紅酒法定產區，以架構感強、深邃的 Pinot Noir 著稱。黑櫻桃、野草及泥土香料，收結有力悠長，具真正的 Burgundy 特質及陳年潛力。

name: La Manufacture Chablis 1er Cru Beauroy 2022
description: Beauroy is a Premier Cru-classified climat of Chablis. Classic Chablis character with good fruit and intense minerality.
description_zh: Beauroy 是 Chablis 一級田，以果香充沛及礦物感強烈著稱。La Manufacture 版本帶白花、柑橘皮及燧石礦物香氣，入口集中帶鹹鮮感，Kimmeridgian 石灰岩土壤賦予精準悠長的收結。
tasting_note: Beauroy is a Premier Cru-classified climat of Chablis. Classic Chablis character with good fruit and intense minerality.

name: La Manufacture Chablis 1er Cru Côte de Lechet 2021
description: Côte de Lechet Premier Cru — some of Chablis' most sought-after wines. Southeasterly aspect gives efficient exposure to morning sun, encouraging slower ripening. Bright and racy with intense minerality. A very classic style of Chablis.
description_zh: Côte de Lechet 是 Chablis 最受追捧的一級田之一。東南向山坡充分接受朝陽，釀出緩慢成熟的果實。清新活潑，礦物感強烈，是 Chablis 的最經典風格，收結尤為悠長。
tasting_note: Côte de Lechet Premier Cru — some of Chablis' most sought-after wines. Southeasterly aspect gives efficient exposure to morning sun, encouraging slower ripening. Bright and racy with intense minerality. A very classic style of Chablis.

name: La Manufacture Chablis 1er Cru Forêts Vieilles Vignes 2022
description: 45-year-old vines on a south-facing hill of high-quality Kimmeridgian soils southwest of Chablis town. Elegant, complex and steely wines with superb minerality.
description_zh: 45 年老藤，種植於 Chablis 鎮西南方向陽山坡的優質 Kimmeridgian 土壤上。Forêts Vieilles Vignes 優雅複雜，鋼鐵般礦物感卓越，老藤的濃縮度賦予一般一級田難得的豐富層次。
tasting_note: 45-year-old vines on a south-facing hill of high-quality Kimmeridgian soils southwest of Chablis town. Elegant, complex and steely wines with superb minerality.

name: La Manufacture Chablis 1er Cru Vaillons Vieilles Vignes 2021
description: One of the largest and well-known Premier Cru climats. Wines tend to be floral and more delicate than other side of river, but still retain Chablis' intense minerality.
description_zh: Vaillons 是 Chablis 面積最大、最著名的一級田之一。河流此岸的酒款偏向花香及細膩風格，同時保留 Chablis 標誌性的強烈礦物感。老藤版本更增添深度與濃縮度。
tasting_note: One of the largest and well-known Premier Cru climats. Wines tend to be floral and more delicate than other side of river, but still retain Chablis' intense minerality.

name: La Manufacture Chablis 1er Cru Montmains 2023
description: From Chablis Premier Cru Montmains. Fresher, mineral and more elegant. Reasonably thin, clayey surface on top of Kimmeridgian marls.
tasting_note: From Chablis Premier Cru Montmains. Fresher, mineral and more elegant. Reasonably thin, clayey surface on top of Kimmeridgian marls.

name: Chateau Mihope Classic Dry Red 2022
tasting_note: Ruby red with vibrant aromas of mint, cherry and mulberry. Rich on the palate with fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity. A lingering finish of subtle vanilla and oak. Approachable and pleasurable.
description: Ruby red with vibrant aromas of mint, cherry and mulberry. Rich on the palate with fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity. A lingering finish of subtle vanilla and oak. Approachable and pleasurable.
description_zh: 寶石紅色，香氣濃郁，有薄荷、櫻桃、桑葚的果香，酒體豐富、單寧綿密，酸度平衡，餘味呈現微妙香草、橡木香氣，整體愉悅，平衡易飲。

name: Chateau Mihope Enjoy Syrah Dry Red 2023
tasting_note: Touches of violets and pepper to the lightly baked dark fruit and sweet spices. Medium-bodied with firm and well-judged tannins and a direct, flavorful finish. — James Suckling
description: Touches of violets and pepper to the lightly baked dark fruit and sweet spices. Medium-bodied with firm and well-judged tannins and a direct, flavorful finish. — James Suckling
description_zh: 紫羅蘭和胡椒的氣息融合輕烤黑色水果及甜美香料，酒體中等，單寧堅實且拿捏得宜，收結直接而充滿風味。— James Suckling

name: Chateau Mihope Limited Release Dry Red 2021
grape: Cabernet Sauvignon 48%, Syrah 18%, Cabernet Gernischt 17%, Merlot 13%, Beimei 4%
tasting_note: Deep ruby in colour. Abundant ripe fruit aromas unfold with layers of spice on the palate. Elegant, refined acidity with firm yet supple tannins. Beautifully complex with a long, pleasurable finish.
description: Deep ruby in colour. Abundant ripe fruit aromas unfold with layers of spice on the palate. Elegant, refined acidity with firm yet supple tannins. Beautifully complex with a long, pleasurable finish.
description_zh: 酒體呈深寶石紅色，濃郁的果香，伴隨著辛香料等芳香在味蕾漸次展開，入口有優雅精緻的酸度，配合細緻有力的單寧，擁有美妙的複雜性，回味悠長愉悅。

name: Chateau Mihope Limited Release Dry Red 2022
grape: Cabernet Sauvignon 40%, Merlot 30%, Marselan 15%, Syrah 5%, Cabernet Gernischt 5%, Beihong 5%
tasting_note: Rich blackberries, spiced dark cherries, black olives and red bell peppers. Full-bodied on the palate with fine-grained, creamy tannins. Flavorful, slightly warming finish.
description: Rich blackberries, spiced dark cherries, black olives and red bell peppers. Full-bodied on the palate with fine-grained, creamy tannins. Flavorful, slightly warming finish.
description_zh: 濃郁的黑莓、香料黑櫻桃、黑橄欖及紅椒香氣。酒體飽滿，單寧細緻如奶油般順滑，收結充滿風味，帶有輕微暖意。

name: Chateau Mihope Reserve Dry Red 2019
tasting_note: Deep ruby with lifted, ripe cassis, black cherry and black plum fruit, a touch of herbaceous character with vanilla and toasty notes. Full-bodied with chewy, coating tannins and a long finish.
description: Deep ruby with lifted, ripe cassis, black cherry and black plum fruit, a touch of herbaceous character with vanilla and toasty notes. Full-bodied with chewy, coating tannins and a long finish.
description_zh: 深寶石紅，散發成熟黑醋栗、黑櫻桃和黑李子的果香，帶有草本、香草及烤麵包氣息。酒體飽滿，單寧厚實而綿密，收結悠長。

name: Chateau Mihope Reserve Dry Red 2021
tasting_note: Rich and opulent nose full of currants, baked olives, red capsicums, cedar and savory tobacco leaves. Rich and flattering, with generous, juicy fruit on the full-bodied palate rounded by tight, chewy tannins. — James Suckling
description: Rich and opulent nose full of currants, baked olives, red capsicums, cedar and savory tobacco leaves. Rich and flattering, with generous, juicy fruit on the full-bodied palate rounded by tight, chewy tannins. — James Suckling
description_zh: 豐富而華麗的鼻香，充滿醋栗、烤橄欖、紅甜椒、雪松及煙草葉氣息。飽滿圓潤，果味豐沛多汁，單寧緊實而具咀嚼感。— James Suckling

name: Chateau Mihope Enjoy Marselan Dry Red 2022
tasting_note: Attractive nose of vanilla and chocolate from the oak, with healthy, vibrant fruit. Full-bodied with a rich, flavorful mid-palate and a long, creamy finish. Tannins are abundant and fine-grained.
description: Attractive nose of vanilla and chocolate from the oak, with healthy, vibrant fruit. Full-bodied with a rich, flavorful mid-palate and a long, creamy finish. Tannins are abundant and fine-grained.
description_zh: 香草和巧克力的橡木香氣迷人，果味充沛活潑。酒體飽滿，中段豐富充滿風味，收結悠長如奶油般順滑，單寧豐富而細膩。

name: Chateau Mihope Artist Dry Red — 《綠色星球》2021
tasting_note: Rich and opulent nose, showing smoky blackberries, graphite, dried lychees and violets. Full-bodied and fine-grained on the palate with rich fruit and a tight, flavorful finish. — James Suckling
description: An artistic collaboration label — the 2021 Artist series features artwork by Pu Yingwei. Rich and opulent nose of smoky blackberries, graphite, dried lychees and violets. Full-bodied and fine-grained with a tight, flavorful finish. — James Suckling
description_zh: 藝術家系列聯名酒款，以蒲英玮作品《綠色星球：人類全景》為標籤。鼻香濃郁，煙燻黑莓、石墨、乾荔枝及紫羅蘭層次豐富，酒體飽滿細膩，收結緊實充滿風味。— James Suckling

name: Chateau Mihope Cabernet Gernischt 2023
tasting_note: Deep ruby with an elegant violet rim. Fresh raspberry and red cherry aromas lead to dark blackberry and blackcurrant. Subtle spice, herbs and a hint of mint add complexity. Silky and round on the palate with firm yet supple tannins, vibrant acidity and a long mineral finish.
description: Deep ruby with an elegant violet rim. Fresh raspberry and red cherry aromas lead to dark blackberry and blackcurrant. Subtle spice, herbs and a hint of mint add complexity. Silky and round on the palate with firm yet supple tannins, vibrant acidity and a long mineral finish.
description_zh: 深邃寶石紅，邊緣泛優雅紫羅蘭光芒。覆盆子、紅櫻桃躍動其間，隨後黑莓、黑醋栗層層展開。香料、草本與薄荷氣息增添複雜度，入口絲滑圓潤，單寧緊實而柔順，酸度清鮮，礦物感收結悠長。

name: Chateau Mihope Dry White 2022
tasting_note: Delicate aromas of lemon, apple, cinnamon and cherry with a light spice and nut character. Refined and well-structured on the palate with seamlessly integrated spice and gentle acidity. Elegant and balanced.
description: Delicate aromas of lemon, apple, cinnamon and cherry with a light spice and nut character. Refined and well-structured on the palate with seamlessly integrated spice and gentle acidity. Elegant and balanced.
description_zh: 細膩的檸檬、蘋果、肉桂及櫻桃香氣，帶有淡淡香料及堅果氣息。口感精緻而結構良好，辛香與溫和酸度完美融合，呈現優雅的平衡。

name: Chateau Mihope Viognier Dry White 2023
tasting_note: Bright pale gold with greenish edges. Opulent peach, nectarine and apricot aromas lead to orange blossom and honeysuckle with hints of honey and vanilla. Full and generous on the palate with gentle acidity balancing the wine's texture. A lingering floral and mineral finish.
description: Bright pale gold with greenish edges. Opulent peach, nectarine and apricot aromas lead to orange blossom and honeysuckle with hints of honey and vanilla. Full and generous on the palate with gentle acidity balancing the wine's texture. A lingering floral and mineral finish.
description_zh: 明亮的淺金黃色，邊緣泛淡青綠光澤。油桃、水蜜桃與杏子的甜美香氣主導，隨後浮現橙花、金銀花芬芳，帶一絲蜂蜜和香草的圓潤感。入口飽滿豐腴，酸度柔和平衡，白花香氣與礦物感在口腔中久久萦繞。

name: Chateau Mihope Chardonnay Dry White 2022
tasting_note: Enticing aromas of citrus, white peach, vanilla and subtle nuts with delicate spice and freshly baked bread. Rich and layered on the palate with a smooth, creamy texture supported by gentle acidity. Excellent balance with an elegant, lingering finish.
description: Enticing aromas of citrus, white peach, vanilla and subtle nuts with delicate spice and freshly baked bread. Rich and layered on the palate with a smooth, creamy texture supported by gentle acidity. Excellent balance with an elegant, lingering finish.
description_zh: 迷人的柑橘、白桃、香草及細微堅果香氣，帶有細緻的香料和新鮮烘烤麵包氣息。口感豐富、層次分明，柔和的酸度支撐著絲滑的奶油質感，展現極佳的平衡，優雅的收尾，悠長的餘味。

name: Chateau Mihope Riesling Dry White 2022
tasting_note: Simple and slightly chalky nose with lots of white pears and nectarines. Generous on the palate with a round, medium to full body. Fresh enough but light and easy in the finish with a sweet-sour undertone. — James Suckling
description: Simple and slightly chalky nose with lots of white pears and nectarines. Generous on the palate with a round, medium to full body. Fresh enough but light and easy in the finish with a sweet-sour undertone. — James Suckling
description_zh: 簡單而略帶白堊質感的鼻香，充滿白梨和油桃果香。口感慷慨，酒體圓潤，中等至飽滿。收結清新輕盈，帶有甜酸的底蘊。— James Suckling

name: Chateau Mihope Italian Riesling Semi-Sweet White 375ml 2024
tasting_note: Fresh and lively with aromas of green grape and white peach leading to lemon zest and delicate acacia blossom. On the palate, the sweetness and acidity are beautifully balanced with a light, juicy texture. Clean and refreshing finish with a lingering floral and mineral note.
description: Fresh and lively with aromas of green grape and white peach leading to lemon zest and delicate acacia blossom. On the palate, the sweetness and acidity are beautifully balanced with a light, juicy texture. Clean and refreshing finish with a lingering floral and mineral note.
description_zh: 清新活潑，青提與白桃香氣撲鼻，隨後浮現檸檬清酸與淡雅槐花芬芳。入口甜酸平衡，口感輕盈多汁，收結清爽利落，花香與礦物感悠然縈繞。375ml。

name: La Grange de l'Oncle Charles La Danse des Corbeaux 2022
grape: Riesling, Sylvaner, Chasselas, Gewurztraminer, Pinot Gris
description: A co-fermented field blend from 50–90-year-old biodynamic vines in Riquewihr, farmed with draft horses by Jérôme François. Aged one year on lees in old barriques with zero added SO2. Intensely aromatic with citrus, tropical fruit, crushed stone and earthy tea; dry, mineral and saline on the finish.
description_zh: 由 Jérôme François 以馬耕作、生物動力法農耕的 50–90 年老藤混釀，採自阿爾薩斯 Riquewihr，舊橡木桶陳年一年，不添加二氧化硫。香氣濃郁，柑橘、熱帶水果、碎石與茶香交織，入口乾爽，礦物感與鹽味收結悠長。
tasting_note: Co-fermented field blend (Riesling, Sylvaner, Chasselas, Gewurztraminer, Pinot Gris). 50–90-year-old biodynamic vines, Riquewihr. Aged one year on lees in barrique. Citrus, tropical fruit, crushed stone, earthy tea. Dry, mineral, saline finish. Zero SO2.

name: Maison A&S Ysée Riesling Macération 2021
description: An extraordinary orange wine from Pierre-Alexandre Soltana and Alexandre Aires. Sourced from a 1972 biodynamic Riesling plot in Molsheim, Alsace — whole-cluster maceration for 6 months in barrel without extraction, then 8 months in tank. No SO2 throughout. Dried citrus peel, apricot and honeyed texture with a savoury tannic grip.
description_zh: 來自 1972 年種植的生物動力農法 Riesling 園區（阿爾薩斯 Molsheim）。整串帶皮浸皮 6 個月，全程不添加二氧化硫。乾燥柑橘皮、杏桃與蜂蜜質感，帶有優雅的單寧收結——一款風格獨特的橙酒。
tasting_note: Orange/skin-contact wine. 1972 biodynamic Riesling, Molsheim, Alsace. 6-month whole-cluster maceration in barrel, no extraction. No SO2. Dried citrus peel, apricot, honeyed texture, savoury tannic grip.

name: Maison Pommier Irancy 2020
description: Isabelle and Denis Pommier are among Chablis' most respected organic growers, and their Irancy is crafted with the same precision. Pinot Noir from multiple parcels north of Chablis — the 2020 shows kirsch, red berry and violet aromas with a mouth-filling richness, fine juicy structure and a mineral finish. Best with 2–3 years' cellaring.
description_zh: 夏布利最受推崇的有機農場之一 Isabelle & Denis Pommier 出品，Irancy 為夏布利北面的 Pinot Noir 法定產區。2020 年份呈現黑櫻桃、紅莓與紫羅蘭香氣，酒體圓潤飽滿，結構細緻，礦物感收結，建議陳放 2–3 年後飲用。
tasting_note: Certified organic Pinot Noir from Irancy, north of Chablis. 2020: kirsch, red berry, violet. Mouth-filling richness, juicy structure, mineral finish. Best after 2–3 years.

name: Domaine La Grapp'A Chardonnay Alba 2021
description: Aurélie Parla and Julien Maublanc source biodynamic Chardonnay from the Ardèche, hand-harvested and directly pressed. Spontaneously fermented and aged 2 years in neutral 400L oak — bottled unfined, unfiltered with no added SO2. Pure, pithy citrus with subtle herbal nuance. A precise, low-intervention Chardonnay of real character.
description_zh: Domaine La Grapp'A 向阿爾代什省生物動力農法果農採購 Chardonnay，手工採收，自然發酵，中性 400 公升橡木桶陳年 2 年，不澄清、不過濾、不添加二氧化硫。純淨的柑橘果味與細緻草本氣息，自然低干預風格。
tasting_note: Biodynamic Chardonnay from Ardèche. Spontaneous ferment, 2 years in neutral 400L oak. Unfined, unfiltered, no added SO2. Pure pithy citrus, subtle herbal nuance.

name: Domaine La Grapp'A Pet Nat Sylvaner 2022
description: A joyful pétillant naturel from La Grapp'A, sourced from Sylvaner vines in Alsace. Bottled before the end of first fermentation — méthode ancestrale — with natural residual sugar balancing Sylvaner's lively acidity. Bright citrus and green apple, lively bubbles, off-dry and utterly refreshing.
description_zh: La Grapp'A 以阿爾薩斯 Sylvaner 釀製的自然氣泡酒（Pétillant Naturel）。採用古法（Méthode Ancestrale），發酵未完成前裝瓶，保留天然氣泡。柑橘與青蘋果香氣，微甜爽口，輕盈歡快。
tasting_note: Méthode ancestrale pétillant naturel, Sylvaner from Alsace. Off-dry, natural residual sugar. Bright citrus and green apple, lively bubbles. Refreshing and joyful.

name: Jean-Baptiste Hardy "Fief de Chaintre" Muscadet 2022
description: From old-vine massale Melon de Bourgogne (1960) planted on loam and silt over gabbro, northern exposure — giving naturally higher acidity and mineral precision. Aged 12 months sur lie in 450L barrels and concrete vats, then 6 months in underground glass-lined vats. Unfined, unfiltered, minimal SO2. Textural richness and stony minerality reminiscent of great Chablis.
description_zh: 1960 年種植的老藤 Melon de Bourgogne，生長於玄武岩上的壤土，天然高酸。12 個月帶酒泥陳年於 450 公升橡木桶及混凝土桶，再於地下玻璃缸陳放 6 個月。不澄清、不過濾、少量二氧化硫。豐富質感與礦石感媲美頂級夏布利。
tasting_note: Old-vine (1960) Melon de Bourgogne, gabbro/loam. 12 months sur lie in barrel + concrete. Unfined, unfiltered. Stony mineral, textural Muscadet resembling great Chablis.

name: Domaine 7 Plume Anjou Rouge 2021
description: Abel Benmaamar farms certified organic vines on schist in Martigné-Briand, Anjou. This 100% Cabernet Franc from 30-year-old vines is aged one year in vat — luminous ruby with expressive raspberry, cherry and delicate florals, a light spice, supple tannins and refreshing acidity. A fluid, joyful Loire red.
description_zh: Abel Benmaamar 於安茹 Martigné-Briand 的頁岩上以有機農法種植 30 年老藤 Cabernet Franc，大桶陳年一年。明亮寶石紅，覆盆子、櫻桃、花香與輕微香料，單寧柔順，酸度清爽——輕盈愉悅的羅亞爾河紅酒。
tasting_note: Certified organic 100% Cabernet Franc. 30-year-old vines on schist, Anjou. Aged one year in vat. Raspberry, cherry, florals, light spice. Supple tannins, refreshing acidity.

name: Jean-Baptiste Hardy "Clos de Lozangère" Muscadet 2022
description: Old-vine massale Melon de Bourgogne (1950) from the Clos de Lozangère — a southern-exposure parcel on sandy loam over gabbro. Aged 12 months sur lie in 450L barrels, then 6 months in underground glass-lined vats. Complex poached orchard fruit, oyster shell and baked pastry; crisp, stony and tangy with a silky mineral palate.
description_zh: 1950 年種植的老藤 Melon de Bourgogne，Clos de Lozangère 南向地塊，生長於玄武岩上的沙質壤土。12 個月帶酒泥陳年，加上 6 個月地下玻璃缸陳放。香煮梨果、牡蠣殼與烘烤糕點香氣，入口清新多石，礦物感絲滑悠長。
tasting_note: Old-vine (1950) Melon de Bourgogne, southern exposure, gabbro/sandy loam. 12 months sur lie in barrel. Complex orchard fruit, oyster shell, baked pastry. Crisp, stony, silky mineral palate.

name: Domaine 7 Nouette Anjou Blanc 2020
description: A single-hectare Chenin Blanc from schist soils in Anjou, certified organic. Aged 15 months in a combination of vat and old barrels, bottled as Vin de France with minimal SO2. Taut and energetic Loire Chenin — citrus, white orchard fruit, herbal notes and saline minerality with a textured, lingering finish.
description_zh: 來自安茹頁岩土壤的單塊 Chenin Blanc，有機農法，大桶與舊橡木桶各半陳年 15 個月，以 Vin de France 形式裝瓶。緊實活潑的羅亞爾河 Chenin — 柑橘、白色水果、草本氣息與鹹鮮礦物感，收結悠長有質感。
tasting_note: Certified organic Chenin Blanc, single hectare on schist, Anjou. 15 months in vat and old barrel. Minimal SO2. Citrus, white orchard fruit, herbal, saline minerality. Long, textured finish.

name: Domaine Les Aricoques Altesse Pan 2023
description: Guillaume Bellon and Romain Dupont founded Domaine Les Aricoques in 2021 in Frangy, Haute-Savoie. This Altesse (65%) blended with Jacquère (35%) comes from 50-year-old vines on glacial moraine soils at 500m altitude. Fermented and aged 6 months in concrete eggs. Complex and exotic with a luscious texture, vivid acidity and a long mineral finish.
description_zh: Guillaume Bellon 與 Romain Dupont 於 2021 年在法國上薩瓦省 Frangy 創立的新興酒莊。Altesse（65%）混釀 Jacquère（35%），來自海拔 500 米冰磧土上的 50 年老藤，混凝土蛋形桶陳年 6 個月。香氣異國風情，口感豐腴，酸度清鮮，礦物感悠長收結。
tasting_note: Altesse 65% + Jacquère 35% from 50-year-old vines on glacial moraine, 500m altitude, Frangy. Aged 6 months in concrete eggs. Complex, exotic, luscious texture, vivid acidity, long mineral finish.

name: Domaine Les Aricoques Gamay Mondeuse Pan 2022
description: Domaine Les Aricoques' red comes from Gamay and Mondeuse grown on glacial moraine in Frangy, Haute-Savoie. Short maceration using a mix of destemmed and whole-cluster fruit, fermented in concrete egg vats. Near-rosé in colour with compact, complex red fruit, fragrant whole-cluster spice and an ethereal Alpine freshness. Unfined, unfiltered, minimal SO2.
description_zh: Les Aricoques 的紅酒，採自薩瓦省 Frangy 冰磧土上的 Gamay 與 Mondeuse，部分去梗、部分整串，混凝土蛋形桶發酵。色澤近似桃紅，紅果緊密，帶整串香料氣息與阿爾卑斯山獨有的清爽靈動，不澄清、不過濾、少量二氧化硫。
tasting_note: Gamay and Mondeuse from glacial moraine, Frangy. Short maceration, concrete egg vats. Near-rosé, red fruit, whole-cluster spice, Alpine freshness. Unfined, unfiltered, minimal SO2.
